name: MicFX Voice Studio v5 · Equalizer APO
description: Preserves the existing MicFX UI and presets, adds native v5 Equalizer APO App Group status, mic EQ/mute and stereo-input diagnostics. Requires MicFX APO v5 Endcord IPA. True stereo Discord output, stock Spotify capture and MP3 recording are not implemented.
